basic_profile.bio: A middle-aged hobbyist living in a rural area of Oregon. Passionate about backyard farming, especially raising chickens. Dislikes the hustle and bustle of city life. Online mostly in the evenings after tending to the farm and on weekends. Works part-time at a local feed store and is single. Enjoys a simple lifestyle and connecting with other like-minded individuals on the internet.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Self-taught in backyard farming and chicken care. Grew up on a farm and has been raising chickens for over a decade. Frequently reads articles and watches videos about animal husbandry to improve skills.
